name: Carpool 拼车管家
description: Multi-tenant seats for shared accounts: binds each client key to exact CPA accounts with fail-closed scheduling, lease expiry and per-seat concurrency / RPM limits, plus a buyer portal (Codex quota countdown, self-service reset credits, client setup guide) an owner admin page, and private per-key request monitoring. / 多人拼车席位：key 精确绑定账号、出错即拒绝、租期到期、席位并发与 RPM 限制，附买家自助 Portal（额度倒计时、自助核销重置卡、客户端接入引导）、车主管理页面和仅当前 Key 可见的请求监控。
author: 212duo
